Aina Patel: hi all! starting today as a solutions engineer. excited to be here. quick logistics q: where do I pick up my laptop and how do I get access to the internal repo? fun fact: I juggle on weekends 🤹

Leo Park: welcome Aina :tada: laptop pickup at People Ops (floor 2) 9-5. i'll send a repo access request. ping me if you don't see invites by EOD. also yes, bring juggling to retro :grin: 

Priya Rao: Hey Aina! IT here. i'll provision your laptop and enroll it in MDM. please stop by the IT desk with your ID or fill the remote pickup form: https://go/redwood/it-pickup. for repo access we need your github handle and manager approval.

Aina Patel: thanks Leo and Priya — my github is @ainap. DMing manager approval now. Also where's the sticker jar? ;)

OnboardingBot: Welcome Aina Patel! You've been added to: #solutions, #new-hires. Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/checklists/1795000001. Verify jumpbox access:
```
ssh aina@jumpbox.redwood
/opt/redwood/bin/onboard-verify --status
```

Leo Park: sticker jar is in kitchen next to the coffee grinder. see you at the Thursday intro lunch!
